aboutPage.heroText: Olive Art Creations is a small family business born from a love of craftsmanship, tradition, and creativity.
aboutPage.journeyTitle: From Years of Craftsmanship to a New Creative Journey
aboutPage.journeyText1: After more than 30 years of hands-on work, I retired and began looking for a meaningful way to fill the new time in my life. Through a relative who worked with olive wood and epoxy resin, I discovered a craft that immediately captured my interest.
aboutPage.journeyText2: What began as curiosity slowly became a passion. Over time, I continued learning, experimenting, and improving both the creative and technical sides of the work.
aboutPage.familyText1: Olive Art Creations is truly a family effort. I create each product by hand, while my daughter Yael manages the digital side of the business, including the website, technology, and online presence.
aboutPage.familyText2: Together, we combine traditional craftsmanship with modern tools to create meaningful products that are personal, unique, and made with care.

contactPage.heroText1: Looking for a personalized Judaica gift, a custom laser engraving, or a unique handmade creation? We would love to hear your ideas and help you create something truly special.
contactPage.heroText2: Every piece is handcrafted with care using natural olive wood, premium epoxy resin, and attention to every detail.
contactPage.handmadeNote: Handcrafted in Israel using natural olive wood and premium epoxy resin.
contactPage.whyContactText: We specialize in handmade Judaica products that can be customized for meaningful occasions, personal gifts, and unique requests.
contactPage.feature3: Wedding and Bar or Bat Mitzvah gifts
contactPage.contactMethodsTitle: Choose the Most Convenient Way to Reach Us
contactPage.contactMethodsText: We will be happy to answer questions, discuss custom orders, and help you choose the right product.
contactPage.whatsappText: The fastest way to ask questions and discuss personalized orders.
contactPage.emailText: For detailed inquiries, custom requests, and order information.
contactPage.instagramText: See our newest creations, behind-the-scenes work, and customer favorites.
contactPage.facebookText: Stay updated with new collections, handmade products, and special offers.
contactPage.personalizedOrdersText: Many of our products can be customized according to your preferences.
contactPage.additionalCharges: Additional charges may apply depending on the requested customization.
contactPage.closingText: Every handmade piece tells a story. We'd be honored to create yours.
contactPage.replyTime: We usually reply within a few hours during business days.
